goal: Close out the two outstanding Tier 1 follow-ups identified in the Pass-2 review of v4-noise-reduction-tier1: (1) eliminate the three remaining 'Untitled' fallbacks in backend services that Tier 1 task 1 missed, and (2) unify the LLM model selection across all five LLM-using services on gpt-5.4-nano with a single source of truth.
userProblem: Tier 1 task 1 grepped mcp_server/ and ui/src/ but missed three backend Python services that still emit the literal string 'Untitled': api/v4_entities.py:3092 (activity update title generator), services/canonical_document.py:8 (markdown export for canonical documents and embeddings), services/v4_extraction.py:245 (recent-context note feed to GPT during extraction). These are reachable from production paths and would re-introduce the very anti-pattern Tier 1 was supposed to eliminate. Separately, the LLM model selection has drifted: .env pins OPENAI_EXTRACTION_MODEL=gpt-5.4-mini, OPENAI_RECONCILIATION_MODEL and OPENAI_SUMMARIZATION_MODEL=gpt-5.4-nano, but the Python defaults in code still say gpt-4o for those plus gpt-4o-mini for ACTIVITY_UPDATE_EXTRACTION_MODEL and gpt-4o for BRIEF_MODEL. Some env vars have no .env override at all. The drift means a fresh deploy without .env (test env, CI, new machine) silently falls back to gpt-4o across the board — inconsistent with the user's intent of running on gpt-5.4-nano end-to-end.
whyNow: Both items are small, low-risk, and complete the work Tier 1 started. The user explicitly asked to finish Tier 1 and unify the LLM model on gpt-5.4-nano. They also asked to use Loopsmith drain mode + a watchdog cron that self-terminates when both deliverables land.

dataOrApiDependencies: OpenAI API key must accept gpt-5.4-nano model id (verified pre-launch via a 1-token ping)

tasks.title: Eliminate 'Untitled' fallback strings in three backend services
tasks.description: Replace three literal 'Untitled' fallbacks in backend services with the same `(no title)` placeholder pattern used by the MCP formatters and the React entityTitleLabel helper. Add a single shared helper in services/title_utils.py (module-level function title_or_placeholder(entity, include_type=True)) so future code can't reintroduce the anti-pattern. Apply it at api/v4_entities.py:3092 (_activity_update_title), services/canonical_document.py:8 (generate_canonical_markdown), and services/v4_extraction.py:245 (recent context note feed). Add unit tests for all three call sites that pin 'Untitled' is not in any output for entities with title=None.

tasks.title: Unify LLM model on gpt-5.4-nano across all five LLM-using services
tasks.description: Replace the four per-service model constants and the activity-update extraction constant in services/v4_extraction.py, services/v4_reconciliation.py, services/v4_summarization.py, services/v4_brief.py with a single canonical default of 'gpt-5.4-nano'. Centralize via a shared services/llm_models.py module that exports resolve_chat_model(env_var, default='gpt-5.4-nano') so each service keeps its existing env-var override path (OPENAI_EXTRACTION_MODEL, etc.) but the code-level default is now gpt-5.4-nano consistently. Do NOT change EMBEDDING_MODEL (text-embedding-3-small) — embeddings are a different model family and the user explicitly excluded them. Add tests/unit/test_model_config.py that pins each of the five services to gpt-5.4-nano by default, and that env-var overrides still win when set. Pre-launch check: verify gpt-5.4-nano is callable from the configured OPENAI_API_KEY (1-token ping) so we don't discover the model id is wrong only after deploy.

tasks.title: Deploy to production and verify
tasks.description: After both code tasks land on main, run scripts/engram-deploy.sh which builds the UI, takes a production backup, restarts the Flask API via launchd, and verifies health. Then verify the live service serves the new code (curl /api/v4/health, grep response for /api/v4/canonical returning non-Untitled for a known null-title entity if one exists, otherwise just confirm the new bundles are being served). Production backup is required by AGENTS.md before any deploy. Skip if either code task fails.

API health endpoint reachable on https://danishs-mac-mini.tail003386.ts.net:5001

nonGoals: Touching EMBEDDING_MODEL or any embeddings code path
Merging branches back to main automatically — that happens at stop-and-verify time
Changing .env file in the repo (env file is per-host)

keyDecisions: Path B (user-confirmed): code-level default is gpt-5.4-nano; env var overrides win when set. Single source of truth via services/llm_models.py.
Embeddings explicitly excluded — different model family, user-confirmed.
Shared Python title_or_placeholder helper added at services/title_utils.py so the anti-pattern cannot recur in backend Python.
Validations use absolute paths (cd /Volumes/lex1t/dev/shared/repos/engram && ...) so they work in both main checkout and worktrees.
Pre-launch 1-token OpenAI ping inside the model task verifies gpt-5.4-nano is actually callable before code is merged.
executorLaunchTimeoutSeconds = 1800 absorbs fresh-build overhead (default 300 is too short for npm build).
TEST_DATABASE_URL uses password 'engram' (matches docker-compose.test.yml), not the production password.
mainRisks: gpt-5.4-nano may not be available on the configured OPENAI_API_KEY — pre-launch ping catches this.
Some test fixtures may have hardcoded 'Untitled' assertions that need updating when we switch to '(no title)'.
The activity_update extraction path may be hit by integration tests with null-title targets; need to verify integration suite still passes.
continuityNote.nextStepIfInterrupted: Both code tasks are independent and can land on separate branches. Deploy depends on both. If interrupted, run `loopsmithctl recover --repo <repo> <attempt-id>` and re-launch with --drain.
